story: Emma and Rosa meet at a cafe in November. Emma wears a yellow dress and carries a bag. They talk about where they live and their trip in August.
title: A Meeting in November
setting: A cozy cafe during a cold autumn day.

characters.name: Emma
characters.look: a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: a girl with long black hair and glasses

sentences.en: It is a cold day in November.
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma with short brown hair and Rosa with long black hair walk outside on a cold day.

sentences.en: Emma and Rosa go to a small cafe.
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma and Rosa walk into a cozy cafe with windows.

sentences.en: Emma wears a beautiful yellow dress.
sentences.zh: Emma穿着一件漂亮的黄色连衣裙。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma with short brown hair wears a bright yellow dress.

sentences.en: She carries a heavy blue bag.
sentences.zh: 她背着一个沉重的蓝色包。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma carries a large blue bag on her shoulder.

sentences.en: They eat breakfast at a small table.
sentences.zh: 她们在小桌子旁吃早餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma and Rosa sit at a table with plates of food and coffee.

sentences.en: Rosa asks her about the hot August.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa looks at Emma and speaks to her.

sentences.en: Emma wants to catch a quick bus.
sentences.zh: Emma想赶上一辆快速的公交车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma looks out the cafe window at a bus passing by.

sentences.en: Four people stop at this nice place.
sentences.zh: 四个人在这个漂亮的地方停了下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Four people stop walking in front of the cafe.

sentences.en: They live in a place near Africa.
sentences.zh: 他们住在靠近非洲的一个地方。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small map on the cafe wall shows a place near Africa.
